item.title: Ninety Days on Our Own: Fortress America and the Field Day Mindset
item.description: A few nights before our weekly ragchew, a good friend of mine sent me an email. He’s an Army veteran who spent years around military aviation, so when he talks about the military, I listen. He’d read a story about something the Pentagon is calling FORTRESS America, and he planned to bring it up on the net. He was blunt about his gut reaction: this is not good. Fifty years ago, he wrote, he was way down the chain of command, but even then he knew the military doesn’t train for something just for the fun of it.

item.title: Sustainable Energy Initiative: LCOE Calculator
item.description: Working alongside the Sustainable Energy Initiative at Stanford University’s Graduate School of Business, my task was to develop an online application that would serve not only Stanford University but also the public at large. Dealing with the nuances of a confidential data backend, coupled with the need to have a responsive web-tool, created several challenges with this project, all of which were exciting to overcome. Today three European universities and several universities in the United States are actively utilizing this tool.

item.title: Emerging Clean Energy Technology Investment Trends
item.description:
This paper, written by Bumpus and Comello and published on Nature.com, discusses Emerging clean energy technology investment trends. My contribution was cleansing, massaging, and developing data analysis to support Bumpus and Comello’s argument. I utilized Matlab, Tableau, and python extensively for this project. Credited for work in acknowledgments.

View the publication.
